description.value: Pappa's Firehall Bistro is a Mediterranean restaurant in Oliver, BC, known for fire-grilled chicken marinated in a citrus-herb blend and slow-cooked ribs. Uniquely, the building's basement houses the Firehall Brewery, whose craft beer flows on tap upstairs alongside estate wines sourced exclusively from Oliver and Osoyoos-area producers. The casual, welcoming atmosphere — with bar stools, tables for groups, and TVs — makes it a natural stop for cyclists passing through the South Okanagan wine country.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the OSM address (6077 Main Street, Oliver, BC), phone (250-498-4867), and business identity. The restaurant specializes in Mediterranean fire-grilled chicken and ribs with an on-site brewery in the basement; the falafel salad listing provides positive evidence for vegetarian options. No mention of bike infrastructure, washrooms, takeout, or Wi-Fi appears anywhere on the site or in OSM tags, so those fields are null. OSM opening hours differ from the website's posted hours, flagged as a concern.
concerns: OSM opening hours (Mo-Sa 11:00-22:00; Su 11:00-21:00) differ from hours listed on the website (Mon-Sat 11am-9pm; Sun 11am-8pm). The website figure appears more current; OSM may need updating.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant in Oliver, BC with a functioning website confirmed as recently as the 2025-09-26 OSM check date. Directly on a key South Okanagan cycling corridor.
